run_explorer_musicgen_base_cached: run the explorer function to launch MusicGen base model training jobs with cached data on 32 GPUs
run_cache_write_jobs: run the cache writing jobs using 10 parallel shards on 8 GPUs each to precompute and store model cache
run_musicgen_training_32gpus: run the MusicGen training job on 32 GPUs using the default small model scale with FSDP enabled
run_musicgen_training_64gpus: run the MusicGen training job on 64 GPUs using the medium model scale with AdamW optimizer
run_musicgen_training_96gpus: run the MusicGen training job on 96 GPUs using the large model scale with classifier-free guidance and word dropout
